people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

translations.web: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, and preach toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the field in the South.
translations.bsb: “Son of man, set your face toward the south, preach against it, and prophesy against the forest of the Negev.
translations.kjv: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
